plan.line: an MPU-6050 motion sensor module (I2C): an accelerometer and a gyroscope; it measures tilt (which way is down), shaking and turning speed in three directions. Use it for tilt games, step counting, a spirit level or detecting a fall. Uses one I2C bus (at most 2 I2C parts).

code.pinLine: MPU-6050 motion sensor {ref} on I2C{bus} (SDA {gpio}, SCL {scl}): i2c{n} = I2C({bus}, sda=Pin({g}), scl=Pin({sclG}), freq=400000) and mpu{n} = MPU6050(i2c{n}). mpu{n}.acceleration() gives (x, y, z) in g: lying flat and still, z is about 1.0 and x, y about 0; tilting moves that 1 g to x or y. mpu{n}.rotation() gives turning speed (x, y, z) in degrees per second, about 0 when still. Readings jitter a little: average a few or use a threshold.
code.moduleRule: mpu6050 when a motion sensor is listed
